name: Hatanaka-san
source:
Hatanaka is a married man and the father of a teenage daughter, he is a construction worker. He broke both legs during a construction site and the chance was that [url=/c78567]Takuya[/url] was his roommate. He is very kind and funny.

Takuya never had to deal with him as a patient, but he knows him very well because of a rumor saying that Hatanaka's wife and daughter are very pretty.
